evidenceBoundary: The compiled Slides bundle runs in the actual sandboxed ExtensionHost. HostServices storage, model and media endpoints are deterministic local fixtures; image/video files are generated local fixtures and Playwright supplies them through real browser file choosers. Tests assert rendered layer/canvas state, persisted project state across host remount, JSON import/export bytes, video seek/capture and the generated-media result. No live Core, external model provider or real camera/device is exercised; generated image, video and carousel content remains fixture output.

assertions.assertionName: Add Shape creates a selectable shape whose fill, type and geometry are persisted.
assertions.assertionMarker: Add Shape inserts a new editable shape layer that accepts color, geometry and shape edits.
